frozen_before: any transcript was opened for this measurement

decisions.statement: PostgreSQL with pgvector is the only persistence and retrieval store; no separate graph database and no orchestration framework are introduced.
Project is a hard isolation boundary: every project-owned query must carry project_id.
External systems remain sources of truth: Engram never writes back to them and never applies model suggestions automatically.
Source revisions and locators are immutable provenance; new knowledge must resolve to a fixed revision and an exact locator.
The versioned item, not the document, is the canonical analysis unit; artifact JSON items are a compatibility representation only.
Versioning is per item: editing one item neither versions the whole document nor touches neighbouring items.
Only confirmed item links may expand retrieval; inferred links are created in the proposed state.
Links are semantically constrained by a type matrix rather than being interchangeable.
Impact analysis is non-mutating: a run changes no active version.
Invalid structured model output is rejected whole, in one transaction; a partially valid answer is not salvaged.
Human review is mandatory: a context package is assembled only from confirmed candidates.
The context budget is enforced after graph expansion, not before it.
Every element of a context package carries a machine-checkable reason for inclusion, its graph path, version and source locator.
GitHub is the first and only source adapter during MVP validation, and it is read-only.
The backend is layered api to services to repositories to models.
Deterministic mock LLM and embedding providers are the default in tests and CI regardless of a developer's local .env.
Candidate review is deliberately not exposed to the agent over the MCP channel.
MCP delivery is split into protocol-independent operations and a stdio adapter behind an optional extra.
Every model change ships with an Alembic migration tested on both existing data and clean installs.
GitHub tokens remain server-side and are never persisted in source configuration.
Auth and roles, collaboration, further integrations, auto-repair, Neo4j, LangGraph and visual polish are frozen until one claim about Engram's value is measured and holds.
Rich-text editing and the generic graph are kept only as diagnostic compatibility surfaces.
Tuning retrieval weights and edge types is frozen; the ceiling is set by budget mechanics, not by the edges.
The primary source of value becomes rationale captured from agent sessions, and impact analysis stops being what Engram calls itself.
Rationale is served by direct link lookup rather than through the scoring and expansion pipeline.
Raw session messages are never persisted; only the extracted decision text and a locator a human can verify against the transcript.
A session must be segmented before extraction, and a segment with wide fan-out produces proposed rather than confirmed links.
A falsification criterion is registered before each measurement, and no project statement may be stronger than the numbers support.
Repeated runs are mandatory in any measurement, and absolute counters are taken from the first run so repeats do not double them.
